confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors align with recent aggregated Santa Fe cost-of-living estimates. Cocktail and wine are estimated at roughly 2x and 1.6x the local draft-beer anchor. Lodging is a broad model estimate and especially uncertain for July peak season.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink use Santa Fe aggregate price estimates; lodging is modeled for a small Southwestern U.S. tourist city with seasonal visitor demand.
